name: LGC Clinical Diagnostics (Maine Standards)
old_description: Maine Standards is a market leader for linearity and calibration verification products. Our modern laboratory and streamlined processes allow us to consistently manufacture products that are of the highest quality, are easy-to-use and are incredibly efficient.
about:
LGC Maine Standards operates from Cumberland Foreside, Maine. The business originated as Maine Standards Company, LLC, a specialist in linearity and calibration verification with more than a century of experience in that niche. In November 2015, the company was acquired by LGC, a global life sciences measurement and testing firm founded in 1842 and now owned by funds affiliated with KKR. The acquisition brought Maine Standards into LGC’s portfolio of reference materials, proficiency testing, and genomics reagents.

At its Maine facility, the company manufactures liquid, ready-to-use, multi-level calibration verification sets under the VALIDATE® brand, designed for the most widely used clinical laboratory instruments. The modern laboratory and streamlined processes support production of these quality-control products, which are shipped on customer schedules. While specific facility size and headcount for the Maine site are not disclosed, LGC employs over 2,000 people across 22 countries.

The products serve clinical laboratories and healthcare professionals across diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, agricultural biotechnology, food safety, environmental testing, government agencies, and academic research. LGC’s broader measurement services also underpin safety and regulatory compliance in these sectors.

The company states its purpose is to improve the quality of human diagnostics, backing its offerings with a 100% customer satisfaction guarantee, expert technical support, and a global logistics network. Compliance with the AdvaMed Code of Ethics and accreditation to standards such as ISO 13485:2016, ISO/IEC 17025, and ISO Guide 34 further distinguish its operations.
